about_the_game:
In Queen’s Revenge, you don’t just command from above—you fight on the front lines. As the queen, you must balance strategic base-building and intense combat.
🌞 Day Phase: Expand your territory by defeating enemies and unlocking new construction sites. Every action consumes day stamina, forcing careful planning.
🌙 Night Phase: Hold the line against waves of enemies, using skill-based combat to protect your stronghold.

The combination of deep strategy and dynamic action creates a unique challenge where every choice matters. Can you outlast the darkness and reclaim your throne?

!!!

The game is currently in the prototype phase. Screenshots and GIFs do not represent the final version—features like enemy death animations are still in development

!!!

Carefully plan your defenses to counter both air and ground units. Build specialized towers to target different enemy types—anti-air turrets for flying threats and powerful ground defenses for heavily armored foes.

A strategic action game with skill-based, direct combat, featuring dodging, blocking, and precise attacks where timing and smart maneuvers determine victory or defeat.

Fight for new building sites! Enemy camps guard valuable land—defeat all enemies in a camp during the day to unlock new construction spots for your defenses.

Survive relentless enemy waves! Each night, foes attack in increasing numbers—use your defenses wisely and fight strategically to protect your camp until dawn.

Strategically place walls and barriers to funnel enemies into kill zones, forcing them through choke points where your defenses are strongest. Adapt your layout to exploit enemy weaknesses and ensure your queen’s survival!

Join My Community!

Be part of the journey! I want to shape this game together with you—your ideas, feedback, and passion will help make it truly great. Let’s create something awesome as a community! 🚀🔥

short_description: Queen’s Revenge is a fast-paced tower defense game where you play as the fallen queen. Build and fortify your defenses by day, then fend off relentless enemy hordes at night. Every action by day drains your stamina—plan wisely, expand strategically, and fight to reclaim your kingdom!
